name: OmniTry-Bench
description:
OmniTry-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Virtual Try-on Anything
	

OmniTry-Bench introduces a comprehensive and diverse benchmark for virtual try-on task, enabling thorough evaluation of common wearable objects across 12 types.

For more details, visit the codebase of OmniTry.

	
		
		Constitution of Benchmark
	



As the above Figure, we gather evaluation samples within 12 common types of wearable objects, which can be summarized into 4 major classes: clothes, shoes, jewelries… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kunbyte/OmniTry-Bench.
evaluation_method: image-generation and perceptual metrics (FID, LPIPS) and human evaluation for realism/fit
general_score_metric: FID (with LPIPS and human evaluation as complementary metrics)
reputation: A recent, practical benchmark hosted on HuggingFace for virtual try-on research; gaining attention among vision researchers working on apparel and image-editing tasks but not yet an established community standard.
